weather_report:
Late morning in Cottesloe settles beneath a polished, ocean-bright sky, the air clean and salt-edged, the horizon drawn with a steady hand. Forecasts keep the canvas cloudless through the afternoon into early evening, so expect unwavering sunshine, high visibility, and that glassy, blue-white glare off the water. UV will be strong to very high from now until the middle of the afternoon; the sun has bite, even when the breeze feels kind.

Dress for radiance rather than warmth: light, breathable layers, a wide-brimmed hat, sunglasses that earn their keep, and sunscreen as routine as your keys. It’s a pleasant day made more comfortable with shade—take a leisurely, cool-handed lunch, run a couple of modest errands on foot while the light is sharp, hang the washing and watch it crisp in minutes, or duck into a quiet shop or the library for a spell. Toward late afternoon, when the light softens to honey and the air eases, a slow wander along the foreshore or a book on a breezy veranda will feel exactly right.
